main_diagnosis: The simulator is missing the M-current (slow muscarinic K+ channel), which is a standard addition to Hodgkin-Huxley models to reproduce spike-frequency adaptation. All five EDITABLE SECTIONs remain empty—no kinetics functions, state variable, initialization, loop update, or current contributions are provided for any extra channel, causing large systematic voltage discrepancies (neg_avg_log_marginal_NLE = 26.3).

issues.description: Missing M-current (slow K+) kinetics, state variable, and current contribution. The activation gate p governs a slow outward K+ current (I_M = gbar_X1 * p * (V - E_K)) that controls spike-frequency adaptation. Without it the model cannot match experimental recordings that show adaptation or subthreshold resonance.
issues.location: All five '# ===== BEGIN EDITABLE SECTION =====' blocks

issues.description: param_j (range [-3000, 0]) is never used and its physical meaning is ambiguous. If the M-current alone does not close the performance gap, a second channel (e.g. Ih hyperpolarisation-activated current with E_h ≈ param_j restricted to plausible values or a slow time-constant multiplier) may be needed, but adding it prematurely would over-complicate the model.
issues.location: params[:, 9] extraction line and all EDITABLE SECTIONs
issues.suggestion: First validate performance after adding the M-current only. If neg_avg_log_marginal_NLE remains above ~10, consider adding an Ih channel: `I_h = gbar_X2 * q * (V - param_j)` with a hyperpolarisation-activated gate q using `q_inf(x) = 1/(1+Exp((x+75)/5.5))` and `tau_q(x) = 1/(0.0005*Exp(-0.1*(x+75)) + 0.0005*Exp(0.1*(x+75)))`, where param_j serves as the reversal potential E_h (clamp to [-100, -20] mV in practice).
